section01.text011: Find learning, ideas, expertise and experiences designed to be shared across borders.
section01.text014: Explore initiatives, projects and meaningful work connected to the humanitarian mission of Echoes.

section02.text027: The Marketplace is built around people: creators, educators, practitioners, makers and communities bringing something meaningful into the world.
section02.text029: Artists, musicians, writers, photographers and storytellers can give their work a place within the ecosystem.
section02.text032: Knowledge and experience become resources when people choose to share them.
section02.text035: Meaningful initiatives can connect with people, ideas and resources through the wider Echoes ecosystem.
section02.text038: Organizations and communities can become part of a network built around shared human values.
section03.text042: The Marketplace connects the cultural, educational, creative and humanitarian layers of Echoes of Humanity in one shared space.
section03.text044: Stories, music, art and conversations give the ecosystem its voice.
section03.text047: Learning turns knowledge into something that can travel from one person to another.
section03.text050: Humanitarian action gives ideas a place in the real world.
section03.text053: Echoes merchandise gives the philosophy of the ecosystem a physical form.

stores.text003: Discover the places where art, music, books, knowledge, meaningful objects and human creativity will live across the Echoes Marketplace.
stores.text005: Original art, photography, prints, visual work and creative editions shaped by human expression.
stores.text008: Independent music, recordings, albums, scores and sound works from across the Echoes creative world.
stores.text011: Books and written works designed for discovery, reading and, where rights allow, secure download.
stores.text014: Official collections, wearable ideas, objects and physical expressions of the Echoes philosophy.
stores.text017: Learning resources, educational creations and knowledge made to travel from one person to another.
stores.text020: Meaningful craft, skills and services that carry the people and stories behind what is offered.
featured.text003: A living window for new releases, featured creations, books, music, art and meaningful objects from across the Echoes Marketplace.
featured.text005: A changing selection of human creativity from artists, makers and independent creators.
featured.text008: A future live stream of newly published products and digital works across participating stores.
featured.text011: Books and written works surfaced from the Digital Library for reading, access or download where rights allow.
featured.text014: Independent releases, recordings and sound works that give the Marketplace a human voice.
library.text003: A future home for books, essays and written works that can be discovered across languages, read online and, where rights allow, downloaded securely.
library.text005: Discover literature, essays, research and independent publishing gathered into one human library.
library.text008: A future reading space designed for works whose access rights allow them to be opened inside Echoes.
library.text011: Digital works can later offer secure downloads when creators, publishers and rights explicitly permit them.
library.text014: Source-language metadata will help readers find relevant works across the multilingual Echoes catalogue.
products.text002: Made by People. Ready to Be Found.
products.text003: A future live catalogue for art, music, books, digital creations, human craft and meaningful objects from across the Echoes Marketplace.
products.text005: Original works, limited editions, photography, prints and visual creations from independent artists.
products.text008: Albums, independent tracks, special recordings, scores and sound works from human creators.
products.text011: Digital art, creative files and original digital works designed to travel without borders.
products.text014: Objects and handmade work that preserve the person, process and story behind what is made.
storefronts.text002: Every Store Has a Human Story
storefronts.text003: A future storefront layer where creators, makers, educators and participating organizations can present their identity, catalogue and work in one place.
storefronts.text005: Each storefront can carry its own name, story, profile and creative identity within the wider Echoes Marketplace.
storefronts.text008: A dedicated space for the products, works and collections offered by one store or creator.
storefronts.text011: Future store-level search will help visitors find relevant works without leaving the storefront.
storefronts.text014: Storefronts can make the creator, maker or organization behind what is offered visible without losing the human connection.
collections.text003: A future curatorial layer that can bring related art, music, books, objects and digital works together around a shared story, theme or human idea.
collections.text005: Selected works can be gathered across stores and creative disciplines without losing the identity of their original creators.
collections.text008: Collections can connect products and creative works through the people, places and stories that give them meaning.
collections.text011: Art, music, books and objects from different languages and regions can meet inside one shared collection.
collections.text014: Future special editions can bring together original works and collaborations created within the Echoes ecosystem.
economy.text002: A Shared Economy Built for People
economy.text003: A future commerce layer designed to connect transparent pricing, Echoes Credits and secure transactions without turning the Marketplace into a speculative financial system.
economy.text005: Products and works can later display understandable local pricing alongside ecosystem value where applicable.
economy.text008: EC is designed as prepaid ecosystem credit for eligible purchases and services, not as cryptocurrency or an investment asset.
economy.text011: A future protected checkout layer can validate pricing and payment before an order enters fulfilment.
economy.text014: Marketplace activity can support creators, participating stores and the wider Echoes ecosystem through transparent flows of value.
